about: A Zig library for reading and writing image files such as PNG, BMP and JPEG.

prs.title: 32-bit BMP images save with the right colors
prs.broken: Saving a 32-bit image as a BMP file wrote a header that did not match the pixel order. Some programs refused the file and others showed the colors swapped.
prs.changed: I made the header describe the pixels in the order they are actually written.
prs.matters: BMP files saved by the library open correctly in other programs.

prs.title: 24-bit BMP images of any width save and load correctly
prs.broken: BMP files need each row padded to a multiple of 4 bytes. The library skipped that, so images of other widths saved as broken files and loaded skewed.
prs.changed: I made it add the padding when saving and skip it when loading.
prs.matters: Images of any width now go in and out of BMP files intact.
